question.value: How much molecular (CO) and neutral (HI) gas does the ultra-diffuse galaxy GAMA 526784 contain, and could a nearby companion have shaped its star formation and star clusters?

evidence.quote: We analyse low- and high-resolution CO observations to place constraints on the molecular gas content of the galaxy, compare them with HI data, and examine the star formation efficiency of GAMA 526784.
